title: Production comedy script
script: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to RoastBench: the solo startup trapped inside one GitHub repository. It has JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, browser tooling, evaluations and model commands—everything except a second contributor. The README promises source-grounded analysis, which is reassuring, because the repository currently has zero stars, zero forks, and maximum confidence. It’s built to roast other projects, while its own traction is still waiting for peer review. A truly democratic awards show: nobody voted, and somehow we’re all presenting.
